$comment: GENERATED by scripts/build-manifest.mjs — do not edit. Agents: pick components / constants from here, rules from docs/QUICK_REF.md.

components.name: Reasoning
components.summary: The model's reasoning above its answer. Open while `busy` (the text streams in), folded to “Đã suy luận trong 12 giây” once it is done; people can open it again. A toggle by the user wins over the automatic open / close.

components.name: ToolCall
components.summary: One tool the agent called: a row with its name and status that opens to show the input (arguments) and the output. Strings show as they are, anything else as formatted JSON; `error` shows in place of the output.

components.name: Sources
components.summary: “3 nguồn” under an answer, opening to the numbered list of pages it used (numbers match its `Citation`s).

components.name: Citation
components.summary: A numbered citation inside answer text, linking to its source; hover or focus shows the title.

components.name: TaskList
components.summary: The agent's plan: steps with their status and a progress count. The running step is marked aria-current.

components.name: ActionConfirmation
components.summary: An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send an email, delete files, spend money). Shows what it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; once decided, the outcome replaces the buttons so the log stays readable.

components.name: FileTree
components.summary: Files and folders (a repo, a diff, an export): a keyboard tree (role="tree"). ↑/↓ move, → opens a folder or enters it, ← closes it or goes to the parent, Home / End, Enter selects a file (or toggles a folder). Paths are the names joined by "/".

components.name: ContextMeter
components.summary: How much of the model's context window is used: a small ring and the percent (role="meter"), with the token counts in a tooltip. Turns amber from 80% and red from 95%, when the app should summarise or start a new chat.

components.name: AppHeader
components.summary: Top bar of the app (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4b).

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: The 1.0 frame of a multi-page app (#144, docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4): - A `canvas` frame (8px padding and gap from sm, none on phones) holding the nav panel and the content column.

components.name: AspectRatio
components.summary: Keeps media (images, video, maps, 3D previews) at a fixed ratio while the width follows the layout.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Standard Bento Tag/Badge primitive with dual-theme tonal matching. Uses 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + high-contrast text adapted for dark and light modes.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Where the page sits in the app: a trail of links, the last item is the current page.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indeterminate activity mark for a button or field running its own action (§13b: no page spinners).

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button and Spinner: the component form of BTN_* / MODAL_BTN_* (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §9).

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Joins related buttons into one segmented control (Lưu | ▾, ‹ Hôm nay ›): shared borders, outer corners only.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: A grid of days (role="grid"): arrows move by day / week, Home / End to the start / end of the week, PageUp / PageDown by month (Shift: by year), Enter / Space pick. Only the focused day is in the tab order.

components.name: Card
components.summary: With `onClick` the card is a button for keyboards and screen readers too: role="button", in the tab order, Enter and Space click it, FOCUS_RING shows focus (a plain <div onClick> is mouse-only). `active` is then its pressed state. With `selectable`, the outer element stays a plain container and renders sibling Checkbox + open button controls so checking and opening never nest interactive elements.

components.name: CardActions
components.summary: Quick actions on a card or media tile (L10): round icon buttons that show on hover or keyboard focus where the device can hover, and one always-visible ⋯ with every action on touch screens.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrows or the dots (scroll-snap, no library).

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Columns per category: grouped (default) or `stacked`. ≤24px columns with 4px rounded tops, a 2px gap between stacked segments. Hover or ←/→ on the focused chart shows every series of a category; the table view lists all values.

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: Lines over an index (usually time), 2px with an end dot; `area` adds a 10% wash under each line. A crosshair snaps to the nearest index on hover or ←/→ and lists every series.

components.name: DonutChart
components.summary: Parts of a whole (≤ 5 slices; fold the rest into "Khác"). Slices are separated by a 2px surface gap; the centre shows the total (or `centerLabel`); the legend lists every slice with its value and share.

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: A small trend line for a KPI tile or a table cell: muted line, the last point in the accent. Decorative detail: the label states the trend for screen readers (first, last, min, max).

components.name: ChatAvatar
components.summary: Small sparkles tile in front of every AI answer (pulses while it streams).

components.name: ChatThinking
components.summary: "Đang suy nghĩ" (or what the AI is doing) with three bouncing dots, while no text has come yet.

components.name: UserMessage
components.summary: The user's message, right-aligned. `failed`: its answer failed (shown dimmed, not sent again).

components.name: AssistantMessage
components.summary: An AI answer, left-aligned behind the avatar. `actions` (copy, feedback) show under it once it is done.

components.name: ChatError
components.summary: A failed answer (or an AI note in a warning tone), with an optional retry.

components.name: ChatCopyButton
components.summary: Copies `text` (an answer, a code block); shows a check for a moment.

components.name: ChatIntro
components.summary: Icon, title and one line above an empty conversation.

components.name: ChatSuggestion
components.summary: One suggested request (a button), or with `href` a link to another site (opens outside the app).

components.name: ChatSuggestions
components.summary: A column of ChatSuggestion rows, with an optional small heading.

components.name: ChatList
components.summary: The scrolling message list (role="log"). Follows new text only while the reader is at the bottom: scrolled up to read, it stays put and offers "jump to latest". Streamed tokens are not read out one by one; when `busy` ends the finished answer (`announcement`, else "answer complete") is announced once. `empty` (only the intro / suggestions showing) keeps it at the top so the intro is read from its start.

components.name: ChatComposer
components.summary: The question field with send / stop, and an optional `toolbar` under it (model picker, attachments). Controlled: the caller keeps the text (so it can fill it, e.g. from a suggestion). Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, and Enter while an input method is composing (Vietnamese Telex / VNI, CJK) only confirms the word. Focus returns to the field once the answer to a typed question is done (not after one the app started itself: that would pop up the keyboard on a tablet).

components.name: ChatModelPicker
components.summary: Provider, model and thinking-effort chips, like the model picker of the Claude / Gemini apps; pass it as the composer `toolbar`. UI only: the app lists what is ready and remembers the pick. The provider chip shows only when more than one provider is offered, as its logo (`icon`; the name is the tooltip and the label in the list); the effort chip only when the model takes one. The chips stay usable while an answer streams (the pick applies to the next question).

components.name: ChatView
components.summary: Loading skeleton, `setup` (e.g. "AI is not set up" + a settings button) in place of the chat, or the list above the composer.

components.name: ChatPanel
components.summary: The side panel an AI conversation opens in. `placement="workspace"`: inside the nearest positioned parent, beside the content (a tool's canvas, the page). `"screen"`: over the whole page as a dialog, also above an open Modal. Phones always get the full screen. Resizable from `sm` (remembered per `widthKey`); Escape and × close it. Keep it mounted with `shown={false}` while it slides out, then unmount.

components.name: ChatAnswer
components.summary: An answer as most chats show it: the error (with retry), the Markdown text with copy, or "thinking" while empty.

components.name: AIChat
components.summary: ChatPanel + ChatView + ChatComposer with the messages drawn the standard way. The app owns `messages` and `busy`; the composer text is kept here unless `value` / `onValueChange` are passed (to fill it from a suggestion).

components.name: Chip
components.summary: On/off toggle chip (multi-select filters, outcome pickers) + the shared chip colours.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button, an optional title (file name, language) and wrapping off, so long lines scroll sideways.

components.name: Command
components.summary: The searchable list itself (inside a page, a Popover or CommandDialog). The input is an ARIA combobox that owns a listbox; the active option follows aria-activedescendant so focus never leaves the input.

components.name: CommandDialog
components.summary: The command palette over the page: a modal dialog near the top, closed by Escape, a click outside or a pick.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: The app-wide "search or create" box (L1): one dialog for search and quick actions, opened with ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Mount it once in the root layout with the app's places; pages add their own items with useRegisterCommands. Groups get `text-overline` headings, actions a coloured tile (`tone`), records a hint line; the footer shows the keys (↑↓ select, ↵ open, ⌘↵ new tab for items with `href`, Esc close). Uncontrolled unless `open` is given.

components.name: CountBadge
components.summary: A count in the brand colour (text-badge, 700), "99+" cap. A plain count that is not an alert passes tone="neutral".

components.name: NewTag
components.summary: "Mới" / "New" tag: the brand colour at 18% behind brand text (or the strong text where the brand text is not AA on it).

components.name: CustomCombobox
components.summary: Free-text input with suggestions (WAI-ARIA combobox): type to filter, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to pick, Escape to close.

components.name: CustomSelect
components.summary: App-styled dropdown (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md: never a native <select>, its OS popup ignores the theme).

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: Sort by a column header (click again to reverse; aria-sort on the header), filter with `search` (every searchable column, case and Vietnamese marks ignored), select rows with a checkbox column (select-all on the page, bulk actions bar), page with Pagination. Shows skeleton rows while `loading` and an EmptyState when nothing is left. When the columns do not fit its own box, columns with a `priority` fold into the first column's second line; what still does not fit scrolls sideways, with a strong line (outline-line) on each edge that has columns past it and the table focusable to scroll by keyboard. The sorted column never folds. Folding is measured after hydration, so a table with priorities may shift once on first load at a narrow width. The order it shows is `sortRows(searchRows(rows, columns, search), columns, sort)` (for DetailOverlay ‹ ›).

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Date field with an app-styled calendar popover (the browser's own date popup is white and ignores the theme).

components.name: DetailOverlay
components.summary: An item of a list opens over the list (L9) instead of on its own page: its own URL (`?open=<id>`), ‹ › (and ← →) through the current result set with "n / N", close / Esc / Back returns to the list at the same scroll position (the list never unmounts).

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: One section that opens and closes under its trigger row.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: A list of sections, one (type="single", default) or several (type="multiple") open at a time. ↑/↓ move between headers, Home / End jump; each header is a button inside a heading (level), its panel a labelled region.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Side sheet for secondary tasks that keep the page in view (filters, record details, settings).

components.name: ExternalLink
components.summary: Links to other sites (docs, shops): always a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14).

components.name: FeatureIntro
components.summary: The first visit of a feature (#94 L14, docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14): a small dialog with a visual, a title, one line, dots, Skip + Next / Get started.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Callout inside a page or form (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §3b): tinted surface, tone icon, optional action / dismiss.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Determinate or indeterminate progress bar (uploads, quotas, print progress).

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Person or team mark: photo, else initials on a tone picked from the name (stable per name).

components.name: LetterAvatar
components.summary: One-letter neutral avatar: the name's first letter upper-cased with the `vi` locale ("?" when empty) on a neutral fill; accessible name = the full name.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Empty list / first-run state (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §13). - `first-use`: nothing exists yet. One icon, one sentence (the title), one primary action (`action`). - `no-results`: a search or filter matched nothing. Own title, and `onClearFilters` adds a "Xoá lọc" button. Below `sm` it takes at most 40% of the viewport (compact padding, scrolls inside if a long text still overflows).

components.name: Field
components.summary: Form field: label + control + hint / error, wired for assistive tech (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md "Form fields").

components.name: Input
components.summary: Text input on the field surface (FIELD_INPUT). For numbers use NumberInput, for dates DatePicker.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text on the field surface (FIELD_TEXTAREA), with optional reply-box auto-grow and top resize edge.

components.name: DropZone
components.summary: Compact FileDrop for a workspace panel (`WorkspaceSection`, L12): a lighter dashed tile on the panel surface (no field fill), smaller type, the same checks (`accept`, `maxSize`, duplicates), keyboard (Enter / Space opens the picker) and announcements. `items` is optional.

components.name: FileDrop
components.summary: Picker + drop area with a row per file (forms, import pages). In a narrow workspace panel use `DropZone`.

components.name: FilterChip
components.summary: One filter facet as a chip. A `multi` filter opens a popover of checkboxes (aria-expanded on the chip); a `switch` filter toggles on click (aria-pressed); a `single` filter opens a menu of radio items (`menuitemradio`) and always reads "Hộp thư: Tất cả". Active (a value other than `clearValue`), it turns solid (`bg-inverted`) and shows the one value or the count.

components.name: FilterOptions
components.summary: The checkbox list of one multi filter (FilterChip's popover, FilterPanel's accordion).

components.name: FilterChipRow
components.summary: The filter chips of a list page on one line. When they overflow, the row scrolls sideways and ‹ › buttons appear (hidden from screen readers and the tab order: every chip is reachable by Tab, which scrolls it into view). "Xoá lọc" shows while a filter is on; `leading` (the page's views as SegmentedControl) sits before the chips; `sort`, `selection` ("Chọn" → in-place `"n đã chọn"` + bulk actions at the same height) and `trailing` (`ViewSwitch`) sit at the right end.

components.name: PhoneFilterBar
components.summary: The filter controls of a phone list page in one row: an optional type menu (the page's views), "Bộ lọc" with the active count (opens FilterPanel), optional `sort` menu, optional `selection` ("Chọn" → replaces the row at the same `h-11` height with `"n đã chọn"`, •••, one bulk button and `"Xong"`), and optional settings. Show below `md` in place of `FilterChipRow` (`md:hidden` / `max-md:hidden`).

components.name: FilterPanel
components.summary: The full filter set in a modal panel: full screen on phones, a right side sheet from `sm` (also the "Bộ lọc" panel of a desktop page with more filters than its chip row shows). Changes apply at once (the list behind updates); "Xem N kết quả" closes. Focus moves in, is trapped, and returns to the opener; Escape closes.

components.name: FormActions
components.summary: Cancel (ghost) then Save / Create (primary), right-aligned, `destructive` on the left. Page forms stick to the bottom of the screen, above the on-screen keyboard and the home indicator; in a Modal pass `placement="modal"` as the footer.

components.name: GuidedEmptyState
components.summary: The first-use state of a page that needs a few steps before it is useful (#94 L13, docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §13): the EmptyState variant "guided".

components.name: HintTextarea
components.summary: A text area that says what it can do (#94 L15, #148, docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §9b): a hint row under the text ("Gõ @ để nhắc nhà cung cấp · Gõ / để chèn mẫu") and a suggestion list portaled with the Popover engine (flips above when there is no room below, never clipped by a pane or modal).

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Shared inline stroke icons + tinted icon tiles (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14–15).

components.name: IconTile
components.summary: Rounded square with an icon: the leading visual of cards, list rows and dialogs.

components.name: InputGroup
components.summary: An input with fixed parts around it: a unit (kg, ₫), a prefix (https://), an icon or a small button (copy, show).

components.name: InputOTP
components.summary: One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): separate boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, autofill from SMS (autocomplete="one-time-code"), screen readers and the native keyboard all work as for a normal field.

components.name: Item
components.summary: A list row: a leading icon / avatar / image, a title with a description, meta on the right and actions.

components.name: ItemGroup
components.summary: Rows in a card with dividers; `label` names the list for screen readers (and shows above it when visible).

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A keyboard key or shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) shown in menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text.

components.name: KpiCard
components.summary: KPI metric card of the Semi Design System.

components.name: ReaderHeader
components.summary: Sticky one-row header of a reader pane (general pattern for mail, tickets, chat; owner decision 2026-11-23): - Left: Back button while the reader replaces the list (wired automatically from `ListReaderLayout`'s `onClose`; below `lg` with your own `onBack`) + wrapping `title` (at least 70% of the row; clamped to 3 lines, the full text in the native tooltip when it is a string) and optional muted `meta` line underneath. - Right: `[•••]` `Menu` (all secondary / overflow actions) then one main `action`, top-aligned (`items-start`), both buttons at identical `md` (`h-control`) height. In a narrow pane, where they do not fit beside a 70% title, they move to their own row under the title, on the right (#188). - Stays sticky (`sticky top-0 z-sticky bg-app`) while the reader body scrolls underneath.

components.name: ListReaderLayout
components.summary: List + reader layout (#149, #118): a list card on the left and a reader card on the right, each its own independent scroll container (`overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain`), filling the remaining height of `AppShell page="fixed"` / `Page fixed` with zero hand-tuned `calc()`. Drive `open` and `onClose` from `useDetailParam()` (`?open=`, Back closes); pass `recordTitle` to add the open record to `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs via `useRecordCrumb`. When the layout itself is narrower than the list + 16px + a 360px reader (a container query, not the viewport: a rail, a sub-nav or a side panel all count), opening an item swaps the reader in place of the list (with `ReaderHeader`'s Back button), so the reader never drops below 360px (#188).

components.name: Markdown
components.summary: Light markdown for AI answers: paragraphs, headings (as bold lines), lists, **bold**, `code`, links.

components.name: MegaMenu
components.summary: Mega menu (#96, L8 of the #94 study): a flyout of links grouped in category columns, each column headed by a text-overline label, links with an optional grey icon, hint and "New" badge, and an optional "See all" link.

components.name: MinimalHeader
components.summary: Minimal page header (#96, L18 of the #94 study): where the page sits on the left (a Breadcrumb, or a title), and at most one text link plus one primary action on the right.

components.name: MobileTabBar
components.summary: Phones (< md): native-style bottom tab bar with up to 6 primary navigation items.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Shared modal dialog of the Semi Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14).

components.name: MultiCombobox
components.summary: Searchable multi-select with removable chips and a portaled search + checkbox popover. Supports option groups (`group`), diacritic-aware search and Vietnamese Telex IME composition.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.summary: Disclosure navigation (buttons with aria-expanded, not an ARIA menu): Enter / Space / ↓ open a panel, Escape closes it and returns focus, a click outside closes it; the current page link gets aria-current.

components.name: NumberInput
components.summary: Drop-in <input> for numbers: on touch screens (phone / iPad: `pointer: coarse`) it opens the app's NumPadPopup instead of the system keyboard; elsewhere it is a plain input.

components.name: OptionCards
components.summary: Selectable option cards with radio-group semantics: icon, name, optional description, 8px grid gap, neutral selected fill (`bg-item-selected`, `border-outline-line`, `text-strong`, no brand tint). Arrow keys move selection and focus; the group is one tab stop.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Short hint for an icon-only control (one line, no interactive content). The trigger keeps its own aria-label; the tooltip is linked with aria-describedby. Touch screens show nothing: never put essential text in a tooltip.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: Action menu behind a trigger button (row / card overflow actions). ↑/↓ move, Enter / Space pick, Escape closes and returns focus. Default trigger: icon-only "more" button; pass `trigger` (an element) to use your own.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.summary: The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus. Use for power-user shortcuts that also exist elsewhere (a row's Menu, a toolbar button).

components.name: Menubar
components.summary: The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): ←/→ move between menus (and switch the open one), ↓ / Enter open, the menus behave like Menu. For page navigation use NavigationMenu or AppShell instead.

components.name: SubNav
components.summary: The 240px sub-navigation card of a `two-column` page (`Page layout="two-column" subNav={<SubNav … />}`): padding 20 / 10, sections separated by a 1px `bg-raised` line, group labels in `text-nav-label` (10 / 500 uppercase faint, row h32, optional 16px icon actions on the right), and items (h32, `rounded-control`, padding 4 / 16, `text-chrome` 12 / 500, 16px icon, 2px apart; inactive `text-muted`, hover `bg-item-hover`, active `bg-item-selected text-strong`).

components.name: PageSection
components.summary: One content section inside `<Page>`: a 20 / 500 heading (`text-section`) spaced 16px (`gap-4`) above its content, with optional actions on the heading row. Multiple `PageSection`s inside `<Page>` sit 32px apart automatically.

components.name: PageGrid
components.summary: Compact 8px (`gap-2`) grid inside a `<PageSection>` or `<Card>`, sized by `@container` width (§4a rhythm).

components.name: Page
components.summary: Shared 1.0 page anatomy and layout inside `AppShell`'s content card (#149, #71): - `layout="work"` (default): flush, no centred max-width, card padding 16 / 24 (`px-4 sm:px-6`). - `layout="reading"`: centred at max 1536px (`max-w-screen-2xl`) inside 16px card padding, 64px bottom padding. - `layout="two-column"`: 240px (`md:w-60`) sub-nav card + 4px gap + main card (padding 24); stacks below `md`. Owns the vertical rhythm from the card top (32px to the header block, 28px from title or tabs to intro / toolbar, 16px from filter toolbar to list, 32px between content blocks), so pages set no margins on those joins.

components.name: PageActionsProvider
components.summary: Page-level actions (Thêm máy in, Thêm automation…) live in the top-right corner of the page header.

components.name: PageActionsSlot
components.summary: Where the actions appear: the right end of the page header row.

components.name: PageActions
components.summary: Renders its children in the page header slot (inline when the page has no slot).

components.name: PageEnter
components.summary: Runs `motion-enter` + `motion-stagger` (first ~10 rows / cards) once per route without adding a layout box (`display: contents`). Wrap `{children}` inside `AppShell` (or pass `enter` on `<Page>`) so the shell stays still and only page content rises in on route changes. Filter, search, sort and `?tab=` changes never replay it, and rows arriving after `windowMs` do not animate. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, entrance is opacity only.

components.name: PageTitle
components.summary: The page's heading (`h1`). By default (`variant="work"`) it is 18 / 400 in the UI sans on the same row as `actions` (wrapping only when the row runs out of room). Pass `variant="reading"` on a one-column reading page for the 44 / 500 display title (`text-title-xl`). Inside `<Page title={…}>`, `<Page>` owns the spacing below this row.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page-number pager: ‹ 1 … 4 [5] 6 … 12 ›.

components.name: PillTabs
components.summary: Default tabs for pages with 5+ sections or sections with icons (settings-like pages, #147): no track, h30 fully round pills (16px icon + 4px gap + 12px/600 label), inactive muted, active strong, with one item-hover pill that slides in 300ms ease-out (motion-slide).

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A non-modal dialog under its trigger. Focus moves into it; Escape, a click outside or tabbing out closes it, and Escape returns focus to the trigger. Controlled with `open` + `onOpenChange`, or on its own.

components.name: HoverCard
components.summary: A preview card while the pointer rests on (or keyboard focus is on) its trigger, usually a link. It adds detail only: touch screens never show it, so the link must work without it.

components.name: Prose
components.summary: Long-form text (help articles, release notes, policies, AI answers rendered by Markdown): headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code and rules styled from the type scale, on the theme's text tokens.

components.name: QRCode
components.summary: A scannable QR code for a payment (VietQR, EMVCo), a receipt or a link.

components.name: RefreshButton
components.summary: Icon-only "Làm mới" page action: reloads the page's data; the icon spins while the reload runs (a button running its own action may show a spinner, §13b).

components.name: ResizablePanels
components.summary: Panels side by side (or stacked) with handles to resize them: an editor beside a preview, a list beside details.

components.name: AccountMenu
components.summary: The account avatar menu of the route header: a one-letter avatar (32px) whose Menu has a header (name, role or email), then the theme (Light / Dark / System), the app's items and sign-out.

components.name: RouteHeader
components.summary: The route header: h60 from `lg` (56 below), padding 0 16px (the content's inset, also on phones, #188), the column's full width; below `sm` the trail shows only the current page. Crumbs enter with `motion-crumb-in` and leave with `motion-crumb-out` (opacity only under reduced motion); the row itself never moves.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.summary: A scrolling region with a fixed size (a long list in a card, a wide table, a log).

components.name: SearchInput
components.summary: Collapsible search box: shows a search icon button by default; expands into the text field on click or when active (value is not empty).

components.name: BarActions
components.summary: Page actions that move inside `SearchPill`'s `trailing` slot while `StickyContextBar` is pinned (`data-stuck`) and hide while the search field has focus (`data-searching`, 150ms fade, out of the accessibility tree and taking zero layout space when hidden so the `"/"` shortcut hint never shifts). Always renders at most **2 slots**, in the title row's order (`[•••][main action]`, 8px apart, last button inset matching the `"/"` hint): with more than two actions (or any `menu` items), the main action stays on the right and the rest collapse into `•••` on the left.

components.name: StickyContextBar
components.summary: The search and filter bar of a list page, pinned to the top of the scrolling content while the rows scroll under it. Pin behaviour (#150): - Pins when the scroller scrolls past the bar, or when the search text field gets focus (250ms ease-out, instant under reduced motion, cancelled by wheel/touch; works on short lists too; chips/sort/view buttons do not pin). - From `md` (768px), pins by layout: the scroller's exact scroll range equals `--sticky-pin` and the list area (or each `ListReaderLayout` panel) scrolls independently with `overscroll-behavior: contain`. Only a new upward wheel gesture starting at the list top unpins; momentum and flings never unpin. Below `md`, keeps native touch scrolling. - Exposes `data-stuck` and `data-searching` on the bar and `--sticky-pin` / `--sticky-view` on the scroller, clearing them on unmount.

components.name: SearchPill
components.summary: The wide pill search of a list page: one per page, it feeds the list (or DataTable). Typing calls `onChange` after `debounce` ms; the clear button and Escape clear at once. A history push of useFilterParams / useDetailParam / openDetail during the debounce sends the pending text first, so the query stays on the entry it was typed on. `focusKey` ("/") focuses it from anywhere on the page (not while typing in another field).

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: Small single-choice filter sets shown in full (2–5 values, often with counts: Đang mở · Đã đóng · Tất cả, #147): a `raised` track (radius 8, padding 4, gap 4, h32) with h24 items (padding 6/16, 12px/600) and one solid `raised-2` pill (white in light theme) that slides in 300ms ease-out (motion-slide).

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A thin divider between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, optionally with a short label in the middle.

components.name: SidePanelToggle
components.summary: The collapse toggle placed at the top of the panel content (next to the first label).

components.name: SidePanel
components.summary: Left settings panel of the stand-alone tool apps: bg-panel, collapses to a thin rail with the same sidebar toggle as the home menu.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: One shimmering block; size and radius come from className (default rounded-control).

components.name: Loading
components.summary: Wrapper that tells assistive tech the region is loading. `relative` keeps the absolute sr-only label inside scroll containers.

components.name: SkeletonCard
components.summary: Card placeholder: icon tile + two text lines, then an optional body block.

components.name: SkeletonGrid
components.summary: Grid of card placeholders (the grid classes should match the real grid).

components.name: SkeletonRows
components.summary: List row placeholders (dialog lists, tables).

components.name: SkeletonList
components.summary: Rows of a divided list (an `ItemGroup`, an inbox, a people list): optional avatar, a title and a meta line, then `columns` short values on the right (from `md` after the first). Matches `Item` rows (`px-4 py-3`).

components.name: SkeletonTable
components.summary: Table-shaped placeholder for a hand-made `Table` (DataTable shows the same shape by itself while `loading`): a header row and `rows` rows of `columns` cells, the first column wider, `numeric` columns right-aligned.

components.name: SkeletonDetail
components.summary: A record's detail panel (a `DetailOverlay`, a side panel, a detail page): title and status, a row of actions, then `fields` label / value pairs and a text block. `side` adds the facts column beside it from `lg`.

components.name: PageSkeleton
components.summary: Whole-page placeholder (Suspense fallbacks, route `loading.tsx`): title row + the shape of the content. `cards` (default) = a grid of cards, `list` = a toolbar and table rows, `detail` = a header card and two panels, `workspace` = a 380px `bg-panel-3` control panel with a bottom action bar beside a result table (stacked below `lg`). Pick the shape the real page has, so nothing jumps when the data arrives (§13b). `inShell` drops the full-viewport height, background and padding: use it in a route `loading.tsx` (the shell and its content slot already give those). Without it the skeleton is a whole page, for a Suspense fallback outside the shell.

components.name: BootLoader
components.summary: Boot / session gate before the app knows its layout (login or shell), the one place a centred spinner is allowed (§13b). Render it once in the root or route-group layout, never inside AppShell content (`boot-loader-place`). Prefer a server-side session check (proxy / async layout), which needs no gate at all.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: One or two thumbs (role="slider"): ←/↓ and →/↑ step, PageUp / PageDown jump 10 steps, Home / End go to the ends; drag or click the track. `value` is a number, or [low, high] with `range`.

components.name: SplitButton
components.summary: One way to start one job (G1): the main action and a ▾ that opens a Menu of the other ways to do it ("Thêm khách hàng" | ▾ Nhập từ file, Tìm trong Data Hub).

components.name: ErrorState
components.summary: Something failed to load or run (route `error.tsx`, a failed fetch). Says what failed and offers a retry; keep any data already loaded on screen and show this in place of the failed part only (§13c).

components.name: NotFound
components.summary: A wrong or removed URL (route `not-found.tsx`, `notFound()`): one sentence and a link home.

components.name: Forbidden
components.summary: Signed in but not allowed (a 403, or a page the role cannot open): say so and link home; do not offer a retry.

components.name: SubpageToolbar
components.summary: Unified sticky sub-page toolbar row (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4a): - Optional title: the page title shares the row with filters and actions (instead of a PageTitle above) - Left slot: filter pills / chips / CustomSelect dropdowns - Right slot: icon-only add CTA (BTN_INVERSE BTN_ICON) + SearchInput + RefreshButton (+ optional extra controls) - Phone layout (#57, opt-in): `filters` (or `left` with `collapseFilters`) go behind a "Bộ lọc · N" button and `secondaryActions` into a ⋯ menu, so below `sm` the toolbar is at most two rows (title, then search + buttons).

components.name: Table
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: THead
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: TBody
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: TR
components.summary: A clickable row (onClick) gets the hover fill and a pointer; give it a link or button inside for keyboard users.

components.name: TH
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: TD
components.summary: `numeric` right-aligns and sets tabular-nums (money, counts, dates); `wrap` lets long text wrap (min 12rem wide).

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: In-page tabs for sections of one record inside a card or dialog (WAI-ARIA tabs: ←/→/Home/End move, the active tab is the only tab stop).

components.name: TaskHost
components.summary: Mounted once in the root layout; renders the task started by `startTask()`.

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: Follows the end of the output while it streams, unless people scrolled up to read. The log is focusable (keyboard scrolling) and not a live region: output read aloud line by line would drown everything else.

components.name: TextTabs
components.summary: Big text tabs as the page heading for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page (#96, #147): display face (`font-display text-tab-xl`, 24px below sm / 28px from sm, weight 400, lh 1.2, tracking -0.01em), every tab in `text-strong`, inactive at opacity 0.2 (raised on hover / keyboard focus in 150ms), active with a 2px brand underline at 6px offset under the word only, gaps 16 / 20 / 24, 28px to the intro below.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.summary: Theme toggle button: seamlessly switches between Dark and Light mode.

components.name: ThemeSwitcher
components.summary: Three-way theme picker (Sáng · Tối · Hệ thống): segmented for settings pages and sidebar footers, `variant="menu"` as one icon button. ThemeToggle is the one-tap dark/light flip.

components.name: ThemeScript
components.summary: Render inside <head> of the root layout, with the same options as ThemeProvider:

components.name: ToastHost
components.summary: Transient feedback after an action ("Đã lưu", "Không kết nối được"): the one toast API (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14c).

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: One button that stays pressed (aria-pressed). Icon-only needs an aria-label.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.summary: A set of toggles on one track. type="single" (default) behaves like a radio group (←/→ move and select); type="multiple" is a toolbar of independent toggles. Value is a list of keys in both cases.

components.name: ViewSwitch
components.summary: Two toggle buttons (list, grid; aria-pressed) and an optional density toggle. Put it in FilterChipRow's `trailing`; keep the choice in the URL (`?view=grid`) or per person (localStorage) as the page needs.

components.name: WorkspaceLayout
components.summary: Page type "workspace" (#94 L12, docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4): a control panel on the left (segmented tabs, back + tool name, sections with a text-overline label and a counter, drop zones, steppers) with the main action pinned at its bottom, and the result on the right.

components.name: WorkspaceHeader
components.summary: Back + tool name (+ one meta line) at the top of the workspace panel; `tabs` (a `ToggleGroup`) sit above it.

components.name: WorkspaceSection
components.summary: A section of the workspace panel: a `text-overline` label, a counter ("3/8") and an optional action on its right.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: − value + for small counts (quantities, copies, seats). The value is a `spinbutton`: ↑ / → add `step`, ↓ / ← take it away, Page Up / Page Down move ten steps, Home / End go to `min` / `max`. The − + buttons are for pointer and touch (out of the Tab order: the keys do the same). Free typing of large numbers is `NumberInput`.

components.name: ConfirmHost
components.summary: Mounted once in the root layout; renders the dialog opened by `confirmDialog()`.

components.name: FormErrorSummary
components.summary: The summary of a form with several errors: an `Alert` listing them, placed above `FormActions`. One error shows only under its field (the summary renders nothing), so a form never says the same thing twice.

components.name: SemiLocaleProvider
components.summary: UI strings of the Semi components (labels, aria-labels, placeholders).

hooks.name: useAppShell
hooks.summary: Inside `AppShell`: whether the nav shows sub-items, whether it is the rail, and the nav shortcuts by item id.

hooks.name: useHotkey
hooks.summary: Register a global shortcut: ⌘ + key on Apple devices, Ctrl + key elsewhere (default K). The handler runs on keydown and the browser action is prevented. It does nothing when a widget already handled the key (`preventDefault()`) or focus is in a rich-text editor (contenteditable), which owns its own Ctrl/⌘ shortcuts.

hooks.name: useRegisterCommands
hooks.summary: Add a page's own items to the CommandPalette while the page is mounted ("Thêm nhà cung cấp" on the suppliers page, the records it shows). Pass a memoised array; the items leave when the page unmounts.

hooks.name: useDetailParam
hooks.summary: The open item of a DetailOverlay in the URL, on the same URL state as useFilterParams (Next App Router safe: `null` history state, deferred listeners, no `useSearchParams`; it follows Back / Forward). Keep the other list state (filters, query, sort) in the URL too, so a shared link opens the same item over the same results. Opening is a history entry, ‹ › replace it, and close goes back when the entry is one this page opened (also after Back then Forward), else removes the param (a deep link), so the list never gets a duplicate entry.

hooks.name: useField
hooks.summary: The surrounding Field's ids and state (null outside a Field).

hooks.name: useListSelection
hooks.summary: Local selection-mode state for list pages (table, card grid or phone `Item` rows): wire `active`, `selected`, `onEnter` and `onExit` to `FilterChipRow` / `PhoneFilterBar` `selection`, and `toggle` / `isChecked` to rows or cards.

hooks.name: useFilterParams
hooks.summary: Filter and sort state in the URL, with no router hook. The server render and hydration see no params (prerender-safe: no `window` in render, no `useSearchParams`, which would suspend a prerendered route); the URL is read right after. Writes use `history.pushState(null, …)` / `replaceState(null, …)`, which Next's App Router turns into its own navigation, so `useSearchParams` and `router.refresh()` keep the filters. It follows Back / Forward, every other useFilterParams on the page, and (where the Navigation API exists, and on any re-render elsewhere) a Link or `router.push` to the same route. Without the Navigation API (Firefox, Safari < 26) a hook in a layout that does not re-render can miss such a navigation: there, and with a router of your own, use the pure helpers (`readFilters`, `writeFilters`, `clearFilters`) on `useSearchParams`.

hooks.name: useCoarsePointer
hooks.summary: True on devices with a touch screen (phones, tablets). Re-evaluated on change. Not just `(pointer: coarse)`: an iPad with a Magic Keyboard / trackpad (typically landscape) reports a fine primary pointer, and iPadOS "desktop website" mode looks like a Mac; both still have a touch screen (`any-pointer: coarse`, `maxTouchPoints`). Macs report 0 touch points.

hooks.name: useRecordCrumb
hooks.summary: A detail page names its record ("DH-1042") for the route header's trail while it is on screen; the crumb goes away when the page unmounts or the label becomes empty. Call it in the page, inside AppShell.

hooks.name: useThemeChoices
hooks.summary: The three choices as Menu radio items (`menuitemradio`; the menu opens on the current one), the current one `checked` (none until the stored theme is known).

hooks.name: useThemeUtility
hooks.summary: The theme as an AppShell `tools` item (for an app without an account; otherwise the route header's account menu holds the theme): an icon that opens a Menu of Light / Dark / System with the current one checked; a level of the phone drawer. Keeps "system", unlike a `toggleTheme` item. ```tsx const theme = useThemeUtility(); ```

hooks.name: useScrollLock
hooks.summary: Lock page scroll while `active` (nested dialogs share one lock). The scrollbar's width is added as padding, so the page behind does not shift sideways when its scrollbar disappears.

hooks.name: useBackdropClose
hooks.summary: Props for a backdrop that wraps its panel: it closes on a click that both starts and ends on the backdrop, so selecting text or dragging from inside the panel and releasing outside does not close the dialog.

hooks.name: useFocusTrap
hooks.summary: Trap keyboard focus inside `ref` while `active`; Escape calls onEscape (only the top dialog closes). Focus goes to the element with [data-autofocus] or [autofocus], else the first focusable, else the container. Inner widgets get Escape first: the trap listens in the bubble phase and does nothing when a widget inside already handled the key (`stopPropagation()` in a React handler, or `preventDefault()`), so Escape in an open select, popover or menu inside a Modal closes that layer, not the Modal. Floating layers portaled to `body` (`FLOATING_LAYER`) keep their own Tab handling; focus that lands anywhere else outside the dialog is sent back.

hooks.name: useDialog
hooks.summary: Everything a modal-like surface needs: focus trap, scroll lock, Escape, and an id for aria-labelledby.

hooks.name: useSemiLocale
hooks.summary: Strings for the current locale (vi unless a SemiLocaleProvider says otherwise).

hooks.name: useTabParam
hooks.summary: Keep the active tab in `?tab=` (or `options.param`), SSR- and prerender-safe: the server render and hydration see `defaultValue`, then the URL is read right after mount. Automatic arrow-key changes always replace the current history entry, so pressing ←/→ across five tabs never pushes five entries.

hooks.name: useUnsavedGuard
hooks.summary: `dirty` is true while the form holds changes that are not saved (compare with the loaded values; false right after a successful save, before navigating on). Prompt texts come from the locale table (`unsavedTitle`, `unsavedChanges`, `leave`, `stay`).

functions.name: navScript
functions.summary: Sets the stored nav choice on <html> before the first paint, so the server HTML's width is the user's (the rules of `readNavChoice`).

functions.name: isoDay
functions.summary: A Date as a local "YYYY-MM-DD".

functions.name: parseDay
functions.summary: "YYYY-MM-DD" → local Date (null when malformed).

functions.name: chipClass
functions.summary: Colour classes of a filter chip (add CHIP_BASE + your own size). Same for every chip.

functions.name: chipIconClass
functions.summary: Text colour of a chip's leading icon: the item's tone (kept when selected, the background is what changes).

functions.name: filterCommands
functions.summary: Items whose label, group or keywords contain every word of the query; label prefix matches first.

functions.name: openCommandPalette
functions.summary: Open (or close) an uncontrolled CommandPalette from anywhere: a SearchPill, a "Tìm hoặc tạo" button.

functions.name: openDetail
functions.summary: Open an item of the DetailOverlay on this route from anywhere (a CommandPalette item, a notification): a new history entry with `?<key>=<id>`, read at once by useDetailParam. Use it instead of `router.push("?open=…")` to the same route: without the Navigation API (Firefox, Safari < 26) the hook cannot hear Next's own same-route navigation unless the list re-renders. For another route, navigate there with the param in the URL (the hook reads it on mount).

functions.name: pageWindow
functions.summary: Page numbers to show around `page` (1-based); `null` = an ellipsis.

functions.name: startTask
functions.summary: Show the blocking task overlay. Starting a task while one runs replaces it; the old handle then does nothing. For work the user can keep going during, use an inline Progress or a toast instead.

functions.name: themeScript
functions.summary: Inline script that sets data-theme + .dark/.light on <html> before the first paint (no flash of the wrong theme). Keep the options identical to ThemeProvider's. Exported as a string for non-React heads.

functions.name: updateToast
functions.summary: Change a toast that is still showing (title, tone, …); its timer restarts. Does nothing once it is closed.

functions.name: dismissToast
functions.summary: Closes a toast. An undo toast closed this way commits (`onCommit`).

functions.name: focusFirstField
functions.summary: Focus the first text-like field inside `root` on devices with a physical keyboard (`(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`), so touch phones keep their on-screen keyboard closed. Does nothing when focus already sits in a field inside `root`. Useful after a tab change inside a settings page. Returns `true` if a field was focused.

functions.name: ensureFocusModality
functions.summary: Tracks whether the latest focus came from a pointer (mouse / touch) vs the keyboard, so text-entry fields — where browsers always match `:focus-visible` even on mouse click — show the 2px focus outline only on keyboard focus. Safe to call multiple times; attaches once per document in the browser, never during SSR.

functions.name: confirmDialog
functions.summary: Resolves true when the user picks the confirm button. A dialog opened while another shows cancels the first.

functions.name: confirmDelete
functions.summary: For an irreversible action: a dialog that names the object, with a red button ("Xoá") and Huỷ. A reversible one is done at once and offers `toast.undo` instead. The texts come from the locale of the provider that wraps `<ConfirmHost />` (`deleteTitle(name)`, `deleteMessage`, `delete`); a prop wins.

functions.name: kindAttrs
functions.summary: The attributes of a kind (an empty object for no kind, so a spread leaves the control alone).

functions.name: readFilterValues
functions.summary: The selected values of every filter, read from the URL.

functions.name: readFilters
functions.summary: The filters with their state, ready for FilterChipRow / FilterPanel.

functions.name: writeFilters
functions.summary: New search params with `patch` applied: each key given is replaced (an empty list removes it); other params (the search query, sort, a page) stay. Pass `specs` to keep the options' order and drop unknown values.

functions.name: clearFilters
functions.summary: New search params without any of these filters (the "Xoá lọc" action).

functions.name: activeFilterCount
functions.summary: How many filters have a value (the count on "Bộ lọc · 2").

functions.name: toQueryString
functions.summary: A query string for a URL: "" when there are no params, else "?a=1&b=2".

functions.name: parseSort
functions.summary: Parse `"key.asc"` / `"key.desc"` into a `DataTableSort` (returns `null` for empty or invalid strings).

functions.name: formatSort
functions.summary: Format a `DataTableSort` as `"key.dir"` (or `""` when `null`).

functions.name: readSort
functions.summary: Read `?sort=key.dir` from search params, falling back to `defaultSort` (default `null`) when absent or invalid.

functions.name: writeSort
functions.summary: New search params with `sort` written as `?sort=key.dir`. Passing `null` or the `defaultSort` removes the param so default URLs stay clean.

functions.name: composeRefs
functions.summary: One callback ref that sets every ref given (the trigger's own `ref` and ours).

functions.name: cloneTrigger
functions.summary: Clone a trigger element with our props without losing its own: event handlers run theirs first, then ours unless theirs called `preventDefault()`; refs are composed; `aria-describedby` ids are joined. Used by Popover, HoverCard, Tooltip and Menu, whose `trigger` is the app's own Button.

functions.name: normalizeSearch
functions.summary: Lowercase, no Vietnamese marks (đ → d): "Đơn hàng" matches "don hang".

functions.name: searchRows
functions.summary: The rows DataTable keeps for `search`: every word of the query (case and Vietnamese marks ignored) must appear in the searchable columns' values (`value`, else `row[key]`; `searchable: false` columns are left out). An empty query returns `rows` itself.

functions.name: sortRows
functions.summary: The rows in DataTable's order for `sort`: numbers by value, text in Vietnamese order with numbers inside compared as numbers ("SO-9" before "SO-10"), empty values (`null` / `undefined`) last in both directions, ties in their input order. No sort, or a key no column has, returns `rows` itself.

functions.name: navigationApi
functions.summary: The Navigation API where the browser has it (Chromium, Safari 26+); Firefox and older Safari have none.

functions.name: holdPending
functions.summary: Hold a pending write until it is sent or cancelled; a push runs it first. Returns the release.

functions.name: flushPending
functions.summary: Send every pending write now (each released before it runs, so a flush that pushes does not loop).

functions.name: writeSearch
functions.summary: Write the search part of the current URL (path and hash kept) and tell the readers. A push first flushes the pending writes onto the current entry; pass a function of the current search to build on what they wrote.

functions.name: patchSearch
functions.summary: Set or remove (`null` / "") params of the current URL.

functions.name: replaceFilters
functions.summary: Replace one or more filters in the current URL without pushing a history entry (for code outside `useFilterParams`, e.g. legacy link rewrites or programmatic resets). Notifies every `useFilterParams` hook on the page.

functions.name: headerPrimary
functions.summary: The app's main action at the right of the header (Slice, Phối màu, Xong).

functions.name: buttonClass
functions.summary: Button's classes: variant × size, icon-only, round, full width, the phone touch size (BTN_HIT), and `relative` unless className positions it.

functions.name: cn
functions.summary: Join class names, skipping falsy parts: cn(BTN_PRIMARY, busy && "opacity-60", className). Later classes are appended, not merged: to change a Semi surface pick another constant / prop instead of overriding it.

constants.name: CHAT_ROW
constants.summary: A tappable row in a chat (suggested request, follow-up choice, link): one look for all of them.

constants.name: CHAT_CHIP
constants.summary: A small label chip in a chat (events, tags the AI understands).

constants.name: CHAT_PICK_CHIP
constants.summary: A compact chip select under the composer field (provider, model, thinking effort).

constants.name: TAG
constants.summary: Static tag (a filament's brand / type on a card): same neutral background for every tag.

constants.name: TONE_DOT
constants.summary: Solid dot in a tone (material / category chips and tags).

constants.name: localIntroStore
constants.summary: The default store: `localStorage["semi_intro_<id>"]`. Blocked storage counts as seen, so nobody is shown it on every visit.

constants.name: BRAND_PATHS
constants.summary: Multi-path or custom styled SVGs for Vietnam Brands & Platforms. Uses Semi semantic tone classes (text-tone-*, text-strong) to preserve characteristic brand colors while respecting flat dark-first surfaces and dual-theme calibration.

constants.name: TILE_TONES
constants.summary: Soft tints of icon tiles: one colour per area (nav tab, page header, card headers of that area) so tabs are easy to tell apart, while chips, pills and buttons stay neutral. Tints only (15% fill + light icon), no gradients.

constants.name: TONE_TEXT
constants.summary: Icon colour of each tone when it stands alone (inactive nav item).

constants.name: BRAND_TONES
constants.summary: Tailored Semantic Tone for each Vietnamese Brand & Platform in Semi style. Matches brand identity while maintaining calibrated dark/light contrast and flat aesthetic.

constants.name: TAB_BAR_PAD
constants.summary: Height of the bar above the safe area; AppShell pads its main scroll area by this much.

constants.name: RecordCrumbContext
constants.summary: The record a detail page shows (internal: AppShell provides it).

constants.name: TOAST_NAV_GRACE
constants.summary: A navigation within this long of an undo toast being shown is that action's own (delete, then `router.push(list)`).

constants.name: STATUS_ICON
constants.summary: Icon + text colour per status tone (shared by Toast and Alert).

constants.name: FLOATING_LAYER
constants.summary: Marks a floating layer (Popover, Menu, select list…) that is rendered in a portal on `body`: focus inside it counts as inside the dialog that opened it, so the focus trap leaves it alone. Spread on the portaled element.

constants.name: FIELD_KINDS
constants.summary: `number` and `money` stay `type="text"` (a native `type="number"` has no keyboard-safe formatting and spinner arrows; `NumberInput` is the number control) and ask for the decimal keypad (the plain numeric one has no separator key, and Vietnamese amounts are typed "1.250.000" or "1,5"). The text then holds separators: parse it with the number helpers (parse in the app by stripping grouping separators / locale-aware parser), not `Number()`. A whole-number field passes `inputMode="numeric"` on the control. A new password field passes `autoComplete="new-password"` on the control. `NumberInput` takes only `autoComplete` and `enterKeyHint` from a kind (it keeps its own type and keypad).

constants.name: SORT_PARAM
constants.summary: Default URL param name for sort state (`?sort=key.dir`).

constants.name: URL_EVENT
constants.summary: Fired after a write here, so every hook on the page (and a second one) re-reads the URL.

constants.name: HEADER_ICON_BTN
constants.summary: Icon-only header button (AI, toggles): 34 px square, bordered. Add `HEADER_ICON_ON` when on.

constants.name: HEADER_PILL
constants.summary: Round pill buttons of the header centre (file badge, save).

constants.name: VIEWPORT_TOOLBAR
constants.summary: Floating tool bar at the top centre of the 3D view (object tools).

constants.name: VIEWPORT_TOOL
constants.summary: A tool of that bar; add `VIEWPORT_TOOL_ON` when active.

constants.name: VIEWPORT_PILL
constants.summary: Undo / redo pill at the bottom centre of the 3D view.

constants.name: VIEWPORT_ROUND_BTN
constants.summary: Round view button at the bottom left of the 3D view (fit the model).

constants.name: VIEWPORT_BADGE
constants.summary: Info badge at the bottom right of the 3D view (size, count).

constants.name: BTN_SUBTLE
constants.summary: Ordinary action (the default): translucent neutral fill (subtle-button), strong text.

constants.name: BTN_SURFACE
constants.summary: Toolbar action (Mời, Tuỳ chỉnh): the raised surface fill.

constants.name: BTN_INVERSE
constants.summary: Main action of a card or of a list page's title row (Thêm, Xem): the strong text colour as the fill.

constants.name: BTN_OUTLINE
constants.summary: Secondary action beside an inverse one (Chia sẻ): transparent with a 1px outline-line.

constants.name: BTN_GHOST
constants.summary: Icon buttons (32×32 with BTN_ICON), the nav bottom row, quiet row actions: no fill, item-hover on hover.

constants.name: BTN_PRIMARY
constants.summary: The one main button of a page, a dialog (its commit: Gửi, Lưu) or the nav: the brand primary fill.

constants.name: BTN_SECONDARY
constants.summary: A second brand main button: the brand secondary fill (the primary when the brand has none).

constants.name: BTN_DANGER
constants.summary: Destructive action (Dừng in, Xoá): the danger status fill (tint + line) with danger text.

constants.name: BTN_ICON
constants.summary: Icon-only button: add to any BTN_* constant (square, h-control); keep `title` + `aria-label`.

constants.name: BTN_SM
constants.summary: Compact (28px, 12px text) for dense rows and toolbars: add to any BTN_* constant.

constants.name: BTN_XS
constants.summary: Smallest (24px, 12px text): the inverse pill of a list title row, chips of actions. Add to any BTN_* constant.

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_SURFACE
constants.summary: Surface / inverse / ghost at dialog size.

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_PRIMARY
constants.summary: Commit action of a dialog (Lưu, In lại, Gửi lệnh): the brand primary.

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_SECONDARY
constants.summary: Second brand action of a dialog: the brand secondary.

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_SUBTLE
constants.summary: Cancel / close in a dialog (Huỷ, Đóng): subtle.

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_OUTLINE
constants.summary: Outlined action in a dialog.

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_DANGER
constants.summary: Destructive confirm in a dialog (Xoá, Dừng in): the danger status fill (tint + line, danger text: AA in both themes).

constants.name: BTN_HIT
constants.summary: 44px touch target on a phone with a touch screen (`pointer-coarse` + `max-sm`): the button itself grows to at least 44 × 44px (min-height / min-width win over the `!h-7` / `!w-7` of sm / xs). Real size, not a pseudo-element, so it never covers a neighbour and never overflows a scroll row. A mouse, a tablet and a desktop keep the drawn size.

constants.name: CARD
constants.summary: Content card (C-030): the card surface (bg-card: dark one step above the panel, light recessed one step below the app), separated by tone, no visible border in Flat and Soft (the style's card border, radius and resting shadow; Sharp keeps its 2px line). Add padding at the call site: p-card (sm:p-panel for a roomy one), never tighter (semi-lint card-padding).

constants.name: CARD_BORDERED
constants.summary: Bordered card for dense data views (a table or a list of rows that needs a frame): the panel fill and a 1px line, the look of CARD before 0.36.

constants.name: CARD_HOVER
constants.summary: Clickable card (opens a detail view): the border shows on hover.

constants.name: CARD_BORDERED_HOVER
constants.summary: Clickable bordered card.

constants.name: HERO
constants.summary: Plain hero panel at the top of a page, on the card surface. No glow (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, "Flat, no glow, no gradients").

constants.name: CARD_ACTIVE
constants.summary: Add to CARD for an active / "on" / printing card: primary border, no glow.

constants.name: STATUS_DOT
constants.summary: Flat status dot (add a size, e.g. `w-2 h-2 rounded-full`).

constants.name: STICKY_TOOLBAR
constants.summary: Sub-page toolbar row (filters left, actions right) that sticks to the top of the scrolling content panel. Bleeds to the panel's side padding so cards scroll under an opaque strip; the negative y margin keeps the layout gap unchanged. On phones it sits below the safe area, which `before:` paints over.

constants.name: TILE
constants.summary: Tonal tile inside a card (stats, readings, nested rows): one step off the card (bg-card-field), no border.

constants.name: SECTION_HEAD
constants.summary:

constants.name: COUNT_BADGE
constants.summary: Attention count (unread, to approve): the brand fill with its on-colour, text-badge (10/700). CountBadge renders it with the 99+ cap.

constants.name: COUNT_BADGE_NEUTRAL
constants.summary: A plain count that is not an alert: neutral.

constants.name: COUNT_BADGE_CORNER
constants.summary: Add to COUNT_BADGE to pin it to the top-right corner of a `relative` icon button.

constants.name: NEW_TAG
constants.summary: "Mới" / "New" tag: the brand colour at 18% (bg-new-tag) behind brand text (text-on-new-tag: the brand, or the strong text where the brand is not AA on that tint; the token build decides).

constants.name: SECTION_LINK
constants.summary: Text link on the right of a section heading ("Quản lý ›").

constants.name: EMPTY
constants.summary: Empty state: dashed card, icon above one short line. Usually a <button> that adds the first item.

constants.name: EMPTY_STATIC
constants.summary: Non-interactive empty state (EmptyState): same dashed card as EMPTY without the hover.

constants.name: EMPTY_PHONE_CAP
constants.summary: Phone cap for an empty or error state (P13): compact padding, at most 40% of the viewport, scrolls inside if a long text still overflows.

constants.name: ICON_BTN
constants.summary: Square icon-only action button in a card header (edit, delete, more).

constants.name: MODAL_CLOSE
constants.summary: Close button in modal headers: visible background pill with clear contrast, easily tappable on dark backgrounds.

constants.name: STATUS_PILL
constants.summary: Status pill (device state, job result): coloured 15% fill + 300 text.

constants.name: TONAL_SURFACE
constants.summary: Dual-theme tonal surfaces: 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + high-contrast text adapted for both dark and light modes.

constants.name: BADGE_BASE
constants.summary: Tonal badge base class (11px or 12px pill).

constants.name: TONAL_CONTAINER
constants.summary: Dual-theme tonal container (cards, callouts, alert banners): 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + dual-theme text.

constants.name: TONAL_HOVER
constants.summary: Dual-theme tonal interactive hover (clickable cards, list rows, buttons): 15% hover fill + 30% hover border.

constants.name: MODAL_BACKDROP
constants.summary: Modal shell: backdrop + panel. Phones (< sm): full screen (edge-to-edge, h-dvh, rounded-none, border-0). iPad / desktop (>= sm): centred dialog (max-h-[92dvh], rounded-panel, border-line). Pass only the max-width at the call site (`max-w-md`…).

constants.name: MODAL_HEAD
constants.summary: Modal header row: icon/title left, close button right. Includes safe-area padding on mobile.

constants.name: MODAL_TITLE
constants.summary: Modal title.

constants.name: MODAL_FOOT
constants.summary: Modal footer: buttons right-aligned; stretched on a phone with safe-area bottom padding.

constants.name: FORM_PAGE
constants.summary: A page form's column (D13): never wider than `max-w-2xl`, fields stacked `gap-stack`, labels above the controls.

constants.name: FORM_ACTIONS
constants.summary: The action row of a form (`FormActions`): right-aligned, a destructive action alone on the left. Phones get 44px buttons from the component.

constants.name: FORM_ACTIONS_STICKY
constants.summary: `FormActions` on a page: sticks to the bottom of the scrolling page, over the page background (`bg-app`; the panel colour inside the AppShell card), with a line above. The component adds the safe-area padding and lifts it above the on-screen keyboard (`bottom`).

constants.name: FIELD_LABEL
constants.summary: Form field label above an input/select/textarea.

constants.name: FIELD_TEXT_PHONE
constants.summary: Text size of a field you type in: 16px below `sm` (iOS Safari zooms the page on focus into a field under 16px and never zooms back), the size of the component from `sm` up. Add it to every text-entry control.

constants.name: FIELD_INPUT
constants.summary: Form text input: 1.0 quiet field (bg-field, 1px field-line, radius 8; darker fill + field-line-focus on focus, no glow; 2px keyboard-only outline).

constants.name: FIELD_TEXTAREA
constants.summary: Form textarea: 1.0 quiet field matching FIELD_INPUT.

constants.name: SHELL_OUTER
constants.summary: The 1.0 shell frame (used by AppShell, #144): `canvas` with 8px padding and gap from sm, none on phones.

constants.name: SHELL_NAV
constants.summary: The nav panel: `panel`, radius 16, a container (`@container/nav`) so the rail hides labels with a container query. Width: AppShell.

constants.name: SHELL_COLUMN
constants.summary: The content column: `app`, radius 16 from sm, holds the route header and the content card.

constants.name: SHELL_CARD
constants.summary: The content card: `panel`, radius 16 from sm, flush with the column, 4px above its bottom, no border. Inside it `bg-app` is the panel colour (`--semi-app`, the variable `bg-app` reads, is set to `--semi-panel` on the card), so sticky strips that paint `bg-app` (STICKY_TOOLBAR, FORM_ACTIONS_STICKY, AppHeader, StickyContextBar) match the card and stay `app` on a page without AppShell.

constants.name: SHELL_CONTAINER
constants.summary: The centred page container inside the card (AppShell without `flush`): at most 1440px, 16 / 24px padding.

constants.name: FOCUS_RING
constants.summary: Keyboard focus ring for custom controls (buttons, tabs, options). Visible on keyboard focus only.

constants.name: HIT_AREA
constants.summary: The click area of a control drawn smaller than 24px (a dot, a thumb, a text button in a line): at least 24 × 24 px around its centre (WCAG 2.5.8), 44 × 44 px on a touch screen, from a pseudo-element, so the visible size and the layout stay. The control needs `relative` (or another position) and no ::before of its own.

constants.name: SEGMENT_ON
constants.summary: The chosen segment of a segmented control (Toggle, theme / style switcher). The tonal fill alone is too faint to tell which one is on, so an inset control-line ring marks it at ≥ 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

constants.name: OVERLAY
constants.summary: Full-screen backdrop of modals, dialogs and sheets (themed overlay colour + blur). Add a z-* layer.
